# How to keep a consistent character in AI video (same face in every shot)

**Turn actor photos or a generated character into multi-scene video where the face, outfit and location stay the same in every shot.**

**Typical cost** with `character-passport`: ~$0.05 per image (Nano Banana 2.1), ~$0.01 per voice take. Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay. **Free, no key:** `media-judge`.

<p><a href="../../varg-consistent-characters/README.md"><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_bba512ea33c7.webp" alt="The same two gym actors stay consistent across vertical scenes: a big man squatting next to a pale-haired coach, then both posing in the same bright studio." width="480"></a></p>

**Short answer:** start with [`varg-consistent-characters`](../../varg-consistent-characters/README.md): profile card per actor, empty location card, approved scene stills, image-to-video with dialogue, one cloud render. The other 4 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill character-passport --skill varg-consistent-characters --skill varg-character-design --skill varg-video-prompting --skill media-judge
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Make a 5-scene ad where actors A1 and A2 from these photos stay identical in every shot, in one kitchen location: ./a1.jpg ./a2.jpg"*

## Requests to paste into your agent

- "Make a 5-scene ad where actors A1 and A2 from these photos stay identical in every shot, in one kitchen location: ./a1.jpg ./a2.jpg"
- "Build a character passport and turnaround sheet for my mascot, then use it in three different scenes."
- "My character's jacket changes colour between shots. Find where and fix it: ./cut.mp4"
- "Remake this reference ad with two new people, same scene script: ./reference.mp4"

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- `character-passport`: ~$0.05 per image (Nano Banana 2.1), ~$0.01 per voice take.
- `varg-consistent-characters`: ~$0.65 stills + ~$4–5 video per 5-scene, 22 s ad (estimate).
- `varg-character-design`: ~$0.06–0.24 per sheet, ~$0.83–2.03 per 5 s clip (tested).
- Any agent that reads Agent Skills: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and others ([install options](../../README.md#install)).

## FAQ

### How do I keep the same face in every AI video shot?

varg-consistent-characters makes one profile card per actor and an empty location card, composites each scene as a still you approve first, then animates it image-to-video with native dialogue audio, trimmed and captioned in one cloud render.

### Can I use real actor photos?

Yes, the pipeline is built for real actor or model photos as well as generated characters.

### What is a character passport?

One paragraph with every visible detail, pasted word for word into every prompt, plus a turnaround sheet, six expressions written as cause and physical tells, and a measured voice line. The builder refuses paraphrased passports.

### Why does my character's outfit or face drift?

Paraphrased descriptions, switching models mid-sequence and weak references. media-judge finds where it happened with a timestamp and evidence, so you regenerate only that shot.

### Is re-rendering expensive?

No. An identical prompt and parameters is a free cache hit locally and on api.varg.ai; the skill's full 5-scene re-render cost a few credits (the stitching fee).
